package.name: mobile_manipulator_demos
package.description:
Progressive demos and failure injection for mobile manipulator learning.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - See complete manipulation pipeline in action - Practice debugging with intentional failures - Build skills progressively from simple to complex - Learn common failure modes and fixes
DEMO PROGRESSION: 01: Arm-Only Joint Control (ros2_control basics) 02: Gripper Control (action servers) 03: Camera TF Alignment (optical frame conventions) 04: Object Detection (OpenCV, pose estimation) 05: Pick-Place Static (full manipulation) 06: Pick-Place Mobile (navigation + manipulation)
FAILURE INJECTION (breakers/): - break_camera_tf.py: TF offset/rotation/stale - break_grasp_frame.py: Wrong grasp pose - break_controller.py: Controller conflicts - break_ik.py: IK failures - break_vision.py: Detection noise
